**Ice Fusion**

Deal 3 arcane damage to any target. If this was **fused** and deals damage to a hero, **freeze** a card in their arsenal until the start of your next turn. Representative only: unfused_three_arcane_preserves_unfrozen_arsenal. Other pitch siblings, alternate targets and unexercised branches receive no credit.
